    Add or remove content from a slide

    content.Rd

    content() lets a user specify a value to add to a slide, and the location on the slide to add it through the ph argument. ph defines the placeholder, or height, width, x and y offset of the bounding box where the content should be added.

    content(
  value,
  ph = ph_body(),
  metadata = NULL,
  ...,
  group_contents = TRUE,
  error_call = current_env()
)

remove_content(ph, error_call = current_env())

    Arguments

    value

    value to be polished and then added at the placeholder defined

    ph

    Defining where values should be added to or removed from. Must be a placeholder object

    metadata

    named character vector of metadata to store in the p:extLst/p:ext/custom:meta/custom:metadata nodes

    ...

    arguments to include when polishing value

    group_contents

    boolean indicating if the polished value should be shown in the powerpoint as a grouped Sp. The default, and for most cases, TRUE.

    error_call

    The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

    Details

    remove_content() on the other hand, lets users specify a placeholder with content that should be removed from the slide using the same placeholder nomenclature. The placeholder must exist in the slide to be removed.

    Examples

    
content("My Title 2", ph = ph_title())
#> $value
#> [1] "My Title 2"
#> 
#> $ph
#> ── reference placeholder with settings:  ───────────────────────────────────────
#> List of 6
#>  $ type       : chr [1:2] "title" "ctrTitle"
#>  $ label      : chr "[Tt]itle"
#>  $ label_from : chr [1:2] "layout" "slide"
#>  $ label_match: chr "match"
#>  $ tie_breaker: chr "top"
#>  $ replace    : logi TRUE
#> ── new placeholder with settings:  ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#> List of 6
#>  $ label: chr "mirage_title_placeholder"
#>  $ type : chr "title"
#>  $ offx : chr "5%"
#>  $ offy : chr "5%"
#>  $ cx   : chr "90%"
#>  $ cy   : chr "12.5%"
#> 
#> $polishing_args
#> list()
#> 
#> $metadata
#> NULL
#> 
#> $group_contents
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "mirage_content"
